referenceLibrary.intro: Documents the organization's assistants draw on and cite: policies, regulations, contracts, specifications and standards. An assistant acting for a role uses a document whose domains the role reads, and every document for the whole organization.
referenceLibrary.empty: The library holds no documents yet.
referenceLibrary.fileHelp: A PDF, Word (.docx), HTML, Markdown or plain-text file.
referenceLibrary.urlHelp: An http(s) address. The document is fetched now and again whenever it is refreshed.
referenceLibrary.titleHelp: Left empty, the document's own title is used.
referenceLibrary.domainsHelp: Roles that read these domains draw on the document. Whole organization stands alone.
referenceLibrary.domainsRequired: Choose at least one domain, or the whole organization.
referenceLibrary.removeConsequence: No assistant draws on "{{title}}" from now on. Terms and definitions that cite it keep their citations.
referenceLibrary.discardConsequence: "{{title}}" leaves the library and no assistant draws on it.
referenceLibrary.needsReembeddingHelp: Embedded with {{model}}, not the organization's current vector model.
referenceLibrary.reembedFailedHeading: These documents could not be re-embedded and are unchanged:
